Veterans Benefits: Oklahoma fully exempts military retirement pay from state income tax for tax year 2022 and after (SB 401). Veterans rated 100% permanent and total, and eligible surviving spouses, receive a full homestead property-tax exemption and a sales-tax exemption up to an annual cap.

Description: Enid is the most affordable city in this batch (typical home about $113,000), built around Vance Air Force Base (71st Flying Training Wing, undergraduate pilot training) in north-central Oklahoma. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Oklahoma's full exemption of military retirement pay, and Walmart access, with an agriculture and energy economy. Tradeoffs include a high crime rate, no local Costco, and a remote location (~90 mi from Oklahoma City).
